confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough: they come from mixed-date travel cost guides and a 2013 wine-list review, not current menus, and the search results contained no current Victoria Falls cocktail price, so cocktail is inferred from the beer anchor. Midrange and accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the supplied context; no live booking pages or listings were inspected. Victoria Falls prices are quoted in USD, but the town is on the Zambia-Zimbabwe border and menu currency and VAT/levy treatment vary. The FX figure comes from a search-result snippet attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open that page directly, and an OFX figure for the same date differed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: tourist-oriented southern African towns with USD-priced hospitality, such as Livingstone (Zambia) and other Zimbabwean resort towns. Food and drink use the search-supported town price range; accommodation is a model estimate reflecting Victoria Falls' higher tourist-season pricing relative to the wider region.
